threads.body: The new guidance says to disable Deploy Previews / PR comment notifications, but it doesn’t explain where/how to do this in Netlify. Please add the concrete UI path (e.g., Site settings → Build & deploy → Deploy contexts → Deploy Previews) and which notification setting(s) to turn off so someone following this doc can reliably apply it.
